answer.location_description: A thin horizontal band spanning the full image width at rows 2-3, near the top edge, well away from the centred nodule.
answer.shortcut_type: horizontal bright line/stripe artifact near top edge
answer.mechanism: Several first-layer 'benign/small-nodule' units (0, 3, 5, 12, 13, 14, 15, 18, 19, 20, 21, 23, 24, 28) put strong, uniform positive weights (about +30 to +65) on every column of rows 2-3. These units feed layer-2 units with negative output weights, mainly u9 (output -95), u12 (-63), u7 (-66) and u0 (-58). The 'malignant' units 9, 16 and 30, which respond to a large bright centre and feed u2, u4, u15 and u1 (positive output weights), carry their most negative weights (about -20 to -59) on the same rows 2-3, while their weights on rows 0-1 and 4-5 are neutral to positive. A bright full-width line at rows 2-3 therefore raises benign evidence and suppresses malignant evidence, pushing the logit negative.
answer.evidence: Row 2 and row 3 weights are uniformly large across all 24 columns, including the corners, in about 14 benign-pathway units. Examples: unit 3 r2 values 40-60, unit 14 r3 values up to 65, unit 18 r3 values up to 70. In malignant units the same rows are consistently negative (unit 16 r2: -42 -26 -29 ... -55 -39 -44; unit 9 r2: -14 -44 -20 ... -48; unit 30 r2/r3: -43 -38 -44 ... -59, -52). Rows 0-1 and 4-5 directly above and below are weak or of the opposite sign. This sharp band edge does not fit a circular nodule or radial structure. A ring-shaped halo would also put matching weights on the left and right edges of the centre rows, and those weights are weak. The other peripheral rows (18-19, 22-23) show only mild negative weights in the malignant units, so rows 2-3 are the distinctive band.
answer.main_feature: Nodule size and brightness: units 9, 16 and 30 respond to a large bright region filling the central rows (about 4-17) and push toward malignant, and unit 27's broad positive weights add net malignant evidence. Units that respond to a small bright core (rows 10-12, columns 10-13) surrounded by dark lung push toward benign.
